items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I believe Johnny St. Cyr was in that band. ... Yeah. well we used to work together.

ctx.x: No, it wasn't that, no. No, they had a whole lot of musicians traveling in Georgia, but if you tell me they had a fine band, they did. I remember Georgia Minstrel. Yeah. John Porter was in there, and I think, and, uh, Charlie McCurdy, and, uh, David Jones, he was quite young. He made all of that. No, after he traveled around, he worked with Chris Kelly around here a long time, and he played those jitney dances. That's about all I knew he played with. Yeah, well that was. On the roof over the minor. That's right,…

You were in that band of Ireland, too, weren't you fast on that? Well, I was on them, I used to play up there. I believe Johnny St. Cyr was in that band. Yeah. I have a picture with you in that band, too. That's right, I was in that. The first night they put the roof over it. They took a picture with a doctor's dance. See, I'll get a copy of that for you sometime.
Yeah, I'd like to see that.
